programme: AusTraits real-effect replication and trait-rank reordering test

prerequisite.rule: No phylogenetic-memory rho is computed unless the exact-crosswalk final core, graph-specific model-informativeness gate, and provenance audit have completed under the frozen v0.6.5 qualification chain.

species_state.numeric: median of deduplicated eligible source-native numeric records in the authoritative standard unit
species_state.categorical: unique modal category across deduplicated eligible records; tied-mode species excluded

effect.primary_scale: source-native state scale on the complete final core
effect.S3: Spearman(all unordered S3 patristic distances, trait-state dissimilarity)
effect.prune_only: same estimator on native GBOTB tips only
effect.direction: larger positive rho = faster loss of trait similarity with phylogenetic separation

secondary_absolute_portability.role: replicate the pre-frozen BIEN-style held-out-family trait predictor
secondary_absolute_portability.prediction: same-trait mean from all other families
secondary_absolute_portability.baseline: global mean from all observations outside the held-out family
secondary_absolute_portability.null: permute rho among observed trait slots within each family
secondary_absolute_portability.robust_rule: positive gain and one-sided p<=0.05 on both S3 and prune-only

secondary_rank_portability.prediction: same-trait mean rank in all other families

matched_raw_log_sensitivity.timing: construct the matched numeric positive-state core before any raw or log rho is computed

direct_reordering.statistic: family-pair-count-weighted probability that two distinct families disagree about which trait in a trait pair has larger memory-loss rho

hard_nonclaims: Do not open real AusTraits rho if qualification is HOLD.
Do not select systems by observed rho.
Do not privilege raw or log scale based on outcome strength.
Do not equate memory-loss rho with evolutionary rate.
Do not infer a causal mechanism from family or system heterogeneity.
